title: Sable and the Choir
author: Petra Brightwater
blurb: Mara Nakamura, a royal food-taster building immunity one dish at a time, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
